open_p4_probe_has_no_per_principal_expectation_carrier: scripts/ops/dev_acceptance_release_probe.py probes a single --login per run and cannot express an allow/deny expectation per principal. The per-principal evidence for this batch therefore came from a read-only shell readback against the same governed environment (.runtime/diag/role_read_probe.py), which is a diagnostic observation, not a governed lane. A future P4 change should add the per-principal expectation carrier so role matrices are reproducible from the registered entry instead of a hand-run readback. This does not weaken the current conclusion - the allowed and denied readings are both explicit and bound to record 36184 on the deployed database. Read-only readback on the deployed acceptance database shows 0 rows for all 13 models, so the defect is latent there and no runtime effect has been observed; two of them (project.boq.analysis.norm.line, project.boq.analysis.resource.line) are the declared source_bounded authority for their models, which is why they cannot be left inferred.
